skills.name: Common-denominator subtraction
skills.definition: Subtract numerators once fractions share a common denominator, keeping that denominator.

skills.name: LCD conversion
skills.definition: Find the least common denominator and convert fractions with unlike denominators into equivalent fractions before subtracting.

skills.name: Mixed-number decomposition
skills.definition: Separate a mixed number (or treat a whole number as whole+0/d) into whole and fractional parts, subtract each part, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrowing/regrouping
skills.definition: When the fractional subtraction yields a negative value, borrow one whole unit (expressed as d/d) and redo the fraction subtraction.

skills.name: Simplification to lowest terms
skills.definition: Reduce a fraction that is not already in lowest terms to its simplest equivalent form.

skills.name: Improper mixed-number normalization
skills.definition: Convert a mixed number whose written fractional part is improper (numerator ≥ denominator) into a proper mixed number before performing subtraction.
